Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE env cert vars and file presence check

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo ENV_VARS
echo RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE="${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-unset}"
echo RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE="${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-unset}"
echo RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE="${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-unset}"
echo 파일존재
for f in "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}"; do
  if [ -n "$f" ]; then
    echo PATH=$f exists=$( [ -f "$f" ] && echo yes || echo no )
  fi
done
echo DIRECT_ETC_PATH_CHECK
for f in /etc/ragin/tls/edge.crt /etc/ragin/tls/edge.key /etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt; do
  echo PATH=$f exists=$( [ -f "$f" ] && echo yes || echo no )
done
echo OPENSSL_CHECK
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo openssl_present=yes
  openssl version 2>/dev/null || true
else
  echo openssl_present=no
fi
echo DONE
